description: This file implements memory management and tensor storage allocation for PyTorch's JIT static runtime, including functions for tensor size alignment, storage assignment, and memory buffer management within the static memory planner classes.

classes.name: ManagedStorages
classes.description: Class managing a collection of StorageImpl objects for tensor storage reuse.

classes.name: MemoryPlanner
classes.description: Base class for managing memory buffers and tensor storage during static runtime execution.

classes.name: StandardMemoryPlanner
classes.description: Derived class implementing memory management with optimized tensor storage assignment.

methods.name: isUnmanagedSpecialCase
methods.description: Checks if a node's output is a special unmanaged case, e.g., to_maybe_copy_out with None output.

methods.name: tensorValueToTensor
methods.description: Maps tensor values to their corresponding at::Tensor pointers.

methods.name: allocate_buffer
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of specified size using CPU caching allocator.

methods.name: assignStorageToManagedTensors
methods.description: Assigns storage groups to managed tensors based on node outputs and ranges.

methods.name: ManagedStorages::append
methods.description: Adds a StorageImpl to the managed storage collection.

methods.name: MemoryPlanner::allocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a memory buffer of given size.

methods.name: MemoryPlanner::allocateOutputTensors
methods.description: Allocates memory for output tensors managed by the runtime.

methods.name: MemoryPlanner::deallocate
methods.description: Cleans up and releases all allocated memory and references.

methods.name: MemoryPlanner::deallocateOutputTensors
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for output tensors.

methods.name: StandardMemoryPlanner::allocateManagedTensors
methods.description: Allocates storage for managed tensors based on precomputed sizes.

methods.name: StandardMemoryPlanner::deallocateManagedTensors
methods.description: Deallocates storage for managed tensors, resetting their buffers.
